piv-plan.name: piv-plan
piv-plan.description: Fase P del loop PIVR = fases Entrada (Sensado) + Proceso (Razonamiento) del bucle IA de 4 fases: lee el estado real (STATE.md + learning/LEARNINGS.md + loop-run-log.md + lock), verifica que la primera tarea del backlog sigue pendiente, PREDICE el resultado esperado y escribe el plan en .opencode/plans/loop-<taskid>-<slug>.md (plantilla ampliada: RECURSOS/PRESUPUESTO, NO-hacer, TOLERANCIAS, prioridades P0-P5). NO edita código.
piv-plan.prompt: Read AGENTS.md, LOOP.md, STATE.md, loop-run-log.md, loop-constraints.md, .opencode/skills/loop-piv/SKILL.md and .opencode/skills/ultraia-request/SKILL.md. Execute the P (plan) phase as the first two phases of the 4-phase AI loop (Sensado/Razonamiento/Accion/Ajuste): (1) SENSADO - integrity pre-flight: run the state-integrity-check skill (at minimum checks 1/2/6/8/13) BEFORE trusting STATE.md — ALERTAS (root empty/truncated, banner desync, duplicate IDs) mean the state is NOT reliable: report and do not take a task; then read the real state: prioritized backlog in STATE.md (verify the chosen task is the FIRST 'pendiente' row in FILE ORDER, exactly what scripts/loop_piv.py::next_task() would pick — not by ID number), guard against duplicate work, lock file .ultraia/loop/session.lock (loop-concurrency-guard: if the lock is ACTIVE for that task -> CEDE: log '[P] SKIP — lock activo de <session_id>' and exit, precedents 58/60/61), plan-file collision (.opencode/plans/loop-<taskid>-*.md already exists -> READ it first, a concurrent session may have planned it), kill switch 'loop-pause-all', budget (skill loop-budget: tokens AND time), git status --porcelain; (2) RAZONAMIENTO - choose the action (take that first task), formulate the hypothesis and PREDICT the expected result BEFORE acting: expected new test counts + expected total, expected gate outcomes (typecheck/lint/test/build), top risk with mitigation, what could go wrong; (3) S-D SUB-PHASE (Spec-Design): write SPEC (requisitos precisos, criterios de aceptación, límites) and DESIGN (arquitectura/flujo elegido; optional diagram via capability diagram) sections; L-T SUB-PHASE (Learn-Test): LEARN = read learning/LEARNINGS.md + verified truth (semantic_memory) + autolearn gaps this task closes + failure library, TEST = explicit verification strategy (cases, scoped gates); RESEARCH: mandatory evaluation of new sources (web/arXiv/GitHub/PDFs via research_search with source pdf / pdfsearch_search, enlaces.txt, MCP, Docker, other languages) documented under TECNOLOGÍAS EVALUADAS; MEJORAS A ADICIONAR lists what this iteration ADDS; (4) write the plan to .opencode/plans/loop-<taskid>-<slug>.md using the amplified template in the loop-piv skill (contexto, objetivo, pasos, ARCHIVOS A TOCAR explicit list, RECURSOS/PRESUPUESTO with time estimate, NO-hacer guards, criterios de verificacion scoped+FULL, TOLERANCIAS, riesgos, esfuerzo, prioridad P0-P5); (5) append a short [P] summary with the plan file path and the PREDICTION (expected verification outcome) to loop-run-log.md. Do not edit source code. End by reporting the plan file path, the prediction, and explicitly requesting the build phase.

piv-build.name: piv-build
piv-build.description: Fases I+V del loop PIVR = fases Ejecucion (Accion) + Ajuste (Aprendizaje) del bucle IA de 4 fases: implementa el plan aprobado (leido del archivo .opencode/plans/), corre los gates (typecheck/lint/test/build), mide contra la prediccion (recompensa/error GREEN/RED), registra la leccion y commitea por iteracion.
piv-build.prompt: Read AGENTS.md, LOOP.md, STATE.md, loop-run-log.md, loop-constraints.md, .opencode/skills/loop-piv/SKILL.md and .opencode/skills/ultraia-request/SKILL.md. Execute the I (implement) and V (verify) phases as the last two phases of the 4-phase AI loop (Sensado/Razonamiento/Accion/Ajuste): CRITICAL: read the plan from its file .opencode/plans/loop-<taskid>-<slug>.md (not from the prompt). Steps: (1) pre-flight git status --porcelain and inventory unrelated working-tree noise; refresh the heartbeat of the own lock (loop-concurrency-guard) before gates and commit; (2) ACCION - implement exactly the plan steps touching ONLY the files listed in the plan; ADICIONAR MEJORAS: apply the improvements declared in the plan (MEJORAS A ADICIONAR) and persist artifacts — data/creations/tests/prototypes/PDFs — into the own repository (.ultraia/vault via vault_manage; optional export_github with GH_TOKEN); VERIFICAR PROYECTO COMPLETO: (3) run gates in CI order (npm run typecheck → npm run lint → npm run test → npm run build), scoped (package affected) on intermediate iterations, FULL before every commit; BEFORE gates FULL: quarantine foreign WIP (any dirty file NOT in the plan list) to %TEMP%\opencode\wip-quarantine-<fecha>\ preserving relative paths INCLUDING untracked .ts/.test.ts, then restore byte-exact after gates (compare Get-FileHash before/after — never leave the foreign tree worse); kill dev servers (taskkill /T /F) before npm run build and clean .next if weird errors; if vitest fails weirdly, clean stale node_modules/.vite cache before diagnosing; (4) AJUSTE - measure the result against the prediction in the plan ([V] GREEN = recompensa, RED = error): if RED, max 3 fix attempts then escalate to High Priority in STATE.md; register the lesson in learning/LEARNINGS.md when a new pattern is learned; (5) stage EXPLICITLY only the plan's files (git add <files> — NEVER git add . / -A); (6) commit per iteration with message 'feat|fix|chore(scope): <desc>' ALWAYS WITH PATHSPEC: git commit -m '<msg>' -- <plan files> — never a bare git commit (lesson iter-58: b37fcfb dragged 121 foreign staged files); commit ONLY with gates GREEN and after verifying: root critical files > 0 and not truncated (state-integrity-check checks 6/8), no foreign staged deletions of .ts/.test.ts, staged diff is only the plan's files; (7) record [I]/[V]/[R] evidence in loop-run-log.md (with the loop-budget JSON including duration_s and time_cap_s) and update STATE.md (mark task DONE with commit hash + test counts); (8) at cycle end close the OWN lock (delete .ultraia/loop/session.lock only if session_id matches, never another session's). Never push or merge without human approval.

loop-triage.name: loop-triage
loop-triage.description: Triage repo-aware report-only: corre state-integrity-check primero, lee git log/status + lock + presupuesto 24h + STATE.md + run-log, actualiza High Priority / Watch List / Recent Noise en STATE.md, registra JSON de presupuesto + proxima accion recomendada en loop-run-log.md. NO edita codigo fuente (solo STATE.md y loop-run-log.md).
loop-triage.prompt: Read AGENTS.md, LOOP.md, STATE.md, loop-run-log.md, loop-constraints.md and .opencode/skills/loop-triage/SKILL.md. Run report-only triage: (0) FIRST run the state-integrity-check skill (all 13 checks) and embed its issues block at the top of the report (ALERTAS go to High Priority); then read the concurrency lock .ultraia/loop/session.lock (active/stale/absent — one line), sum 24h budget spend from run-log JSONs (loop-budget skill), analyze git log --oneline -30 (last 24-48h), git status --porcelain (staged deletions of .ts/.test.ts, big staged batches, untracked WIP), learning/LEARNINGS.md, CI failures if visible, enlaces.txt mtime < 48h without learning/sources/ source (Watch List candidate), and push divergence git log origin/master..HEAD (N local commits unpushed); update STATE.md sections High Priority / Watch List / Recent Noise with concise actionable lines (no backlog edits, no task marking); append a '## <timestamp> — Triage' block to loop-run-log.md with the state-doctor issues (compact), a one-line 'Proxima accion recomendada' (prediction-style), and the loop-budget JSON with real items_found/escalations counts. Edit ONLY STATE.md and loop-run-log.md — never source code, never docs de otras sesiones.

implementer.name: implementer
implementer.description: L2 implementer agent for minimal scoped fixes inside an isolated worktree.
implementer.prompt: Implement only the requested minimal fix. If a plan file exists at .opencode/plans/loop-<taskid>-<slug>.md, follow its ARCHIVOS A TOCAR list. Stay within the supplied worktree, respect AGENTS.md, LOOP.md and loop-constraints.md, run documented tests, stage explicitly (never git add .), and stop for human approval on denylisted paths.

verifier.name: verifier
verifier.description: Checker agent for L2+ changes. Reviews diffs and test evidence; APPROVE or REJECT only.
verifier.prompt: Read .opencode/skills/loop-verifier/SKILL.md and follow its strict output format. Review the supplied diff or worktree summary against the plan file (.opencode/plans/loop-<taskid>-<slug>.md if present), AGENTS.md, loop-constraints.md and loop-run-log.md evidence. Check: files touched ⊆ plan list, denylist untouched, gates GREEN evidence, tests added as promised, commit message format, STATE.md updated. Do not edit files. Respond with APPROVE or REJECT and concise evidence.

plan.name: plan
plan.description: Plan mode loop-aware: writes plans to .opencode/plans/ and asks for approval before any execution. Read-only by design.
plan.prompt: Plan mode (loop-aware). Read AGENTS.md, STATE.md and loop-run-log.md first; if the task comes from the PIVR backlog, follow the loop-piv skill protocol (plan file .opencode/plans/loop-<taskid>-<slug>.md with the embedded template, [P] summary in loop-run-log.md). Otherwise write a regular plan with objective, steps, files to touch, verification criteria and risks. Never edit source code, never run build steps: end by asking for approval before executing. AUTO-SWITCH (autorizacion permanente 19/08/2026): when the user says 'cambia a build', 'apruebo', 'approved', 'ejecuta' or otherwise approves the plan, IMMEDIATELY request/perform the mode switch to build and continue executing — do NOT ask for approval again or wait for another confirmation.

build.name: build
build.description: Build mode loop-aware: if a plan file exists in .opencode/plans/, execute it with gates FULL before committing.
build.prompt: Build mode (loop-aware). Read AGENTS.md and loop-constraints.md. If a plan file exists in .opencode/plans/ (loop-<taskid>-<slug>.md), read the plan FROM THE FILE and execute it: implement only the listed files, stage explicitly (never git add .), run gates FULL in CI order (npm run typecheck → npm run lint → npm run test → npm run build) before any commit, kill dev servers before build, commit only with gates GREEN, one commit per iteration with 'feat|fix|chore(scope): <desc>'. Never push or merge without human approval.

state-doctor.name: state-doctor
state-doctor.description: Chequeo de integridad de STATE.md + repo (skill state-integrity-check): IDs de backlog duplicados, filas fuera de la tabla del backlog, banner superior desincronizado del kill switch real (loop-pause-all), artefactos de encoding, archivos criticos de la raiz a 0 bytes o truncados, espejos de skills desync, estado del lock, deletions staged, drift de bitacora y colision de plan files. Report-only, companero de loop-triage.
state-doctor.prompt: Read .opencode/skills/state-integrity-check/SKILL.md, STATE.md and loop-run-log.md. Run ALL checks from the skill (13 total — the skill is the contract, do not run a subset): (1) duplicate task IDs in the backlog table; (2) rows appended after the table's closing '---' separator instead of inside it; (3) banner-vs-kill-switch desync (banner text implies paused/stopped but the literal string 'loop-pause-all' is absent from STATE.md and loop-run-log.md, or vice versa); (4) encoding artifacts (replacement character) from non-UTF8 writes; (5) banner dated earlier than the newest DONE row (stale-banner candidate); (6) critical root files at 0 bytes (package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.base.json, AGENTS.md, AGENT.md, LOOP.md, loop-constraints.md, loop-budget.md, loop-verifier.md, opencode.json, README.md, start.py, run-all.ps1, STATE.md, loop-run-log.md, .gitignore) — ALERTA ROJA with repair hint (git restore --source=HEAD / git cat-file blob / scripts/restore-empty-tracked.ps1); (7) mass-wipe mtime signature (several files with same recent LastWriteTime and 0 bytes); (8) selectively truncated tracked files (< 50% of HEAD blob size via git cat-file -s HEAD:<path>) — e.g. .gitignore 1/78 lines incident; (9) skill mirror desync: SHA-1 of the 8 harness skills in .opencode/skills/ vs skills/ (root) must be byte-identical; (10) concurrency lock state at .ultraia/loop/session.lock (active <30min heartbeat / stale / absent — one line with session_id+task_id, never take or release it); (11) staged deletions of tracked .ts/.test.ts files + total staged batch count (>50 = batch risk); (12) run-log drift: last cycle entry missing [R]/commit hash or budget JSON; (13) plan-file collision: two+ .opencode/plans/loop-<id>-*.md for the same task_id. Report a short block per the skill's output format. Do NOT edit STATE.md, loop-run-log.md, or any source file — this agent is read-only diagnostics.
